correctness.rationale: Differentiating individual concave payoffs gives b(y)=sqrt(y)−y and F_c(y)=sqrt(b(y)/c)−b(y), valid for positive rival efforts. For c>4/25, F maps (0,1) into itself. Unique Nash y*=1/(1+c)^2 has F'(y*)=−(1−c)^2/(4c), yielding exact local threshold 3−2sqrt(2). F²−id is positive near 0, negative immediately left of the repelling Nash, positive immediately right, and negative near 1, so IVT gives interior genuine two-cycle. Independent Fraction/isqrt outward interval arithmetic verified for c=1/6, J=[0.26299,0.26300], F(J) in (0.97447,0.97455), opposite endpoint signs and (F²)'(J) in (0.17,0.18), rigorously establishing attraction. No global attractor classification.
